info.name: SCRUM-133 Economic indicators
info.description: Import and read county economic indicators (docs/economic-indicators.md). Set baseUrl, admin_token (Keycloak realm role admin) and user_token (a user without the admin role). Needs migration V50 and internet access to api.bls.gov and www2.census.gov. Run folders 1 to 4 in order; folder 5 is optional. The data is public and owned by no user, so access is checked on the admin role instead of ownership. No secret is stored in this file.

item.name: 1 Access (admin role)
02 Import as a user without the admin role (403)
03 Read without token: public reference data (200)

item.description: Imports need the admin realm role. The indicators are public data owned by no user: there is no ownership check.

item.name: 04 List indicators: 7 definitions with unit, frequency, geography and source

exec: pm.test('BLS is monthly, Census annual: never mixed', () => d.forEach(i => pm.expect(i.frequency).to.eql(i.source === 'BLS_LAUS' ? 'MONTHLY' : 'ANNUAL')));

item.description: Rejected before any provider is called: nothing is stored.

item.name: 4 Success and revisions

exec: pm.test('Census, Florida, 67 counties', () => { pm.expect(d.source).to.eql('CENSUS_PEP'); pm.expect(d.stateFips).to.eql('12'); pm.expect(d.counties).to.eql(67); });
pm.test('1139 values (67 counties x (5 populations + 4 years x 3 migrations))', () => pm.expect(d.received).to.eql(1139));
pm.test('received = inserted + revised + unchanged + olderVintage', () => pm.expect(d.inserted + d.revised + d.unchanged + d.olderVintage).to.eql(d.received));
pm.test('received = inserted + revised + unchanged + olderVintage', () => pm.expect(d.inserted + d.revised + d.unchanged + d.olderVintage).to.eql(d.received));
pm.test('nothing skipped: 2025 is the newest vintage', () => pm.expect(d.olderVintage).to.eql(0));
pm.test('first run: 268 new values for 2025 and 1070 revisions (later runs: unchanged)', () => pm.expect(d.inserted + d.revised === 1338 || d.unchanged === 1407).to.be.true);

item.name: 23 Census vintage 2025 again: no duplicate, all unchanged
24 Census vintage 2024 again: an older vintage never overwrites

exec: pm.test('all 1139 skipped as older vintage', () => pm.expect(d.olderVintage).to.eql(1139));

item.name: 25 Miami-Dade population 2024: revised value and previous value

exec: pm.test('one annual value in persons', () => { pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('OK'); pm.expect(d.frequency).to.eql('ANNUAL'); pm.expect(d.unit).to.eql('PERSONS'); pm.expect(d.observations.length).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('vintage 2024 value kept as previousValue', () => { pm.expect(o.previousValue).to.eql(2838461); pm.expect(o.revisionCount).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(o.revisedAt).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: 26 Miami-Dade net migration: July 1 to June 30, from 2021

exec: pm.test('2021 to 2025, no partial 2020', () => pm.expect(d.observations.map(o => o.period)).to.eql(['2021', '2022', '2023', '2024', '2025']));
pm.test('each period is July 1 to June 30', () => d.observations.forEach(o => { pm.expect(o.periodStart.slice(5)).to.eql('07-01'); pm.expect(o.periodEnd.slice(5)).to.eql('06-30'); }));
pm.test('received = inserted + revised + unchanged + olderVintage', () => pm.expect(d.inserted + d.revised + d.unchanged + d.olderVintage).to.eql(d.received));
pm.test('vintage is the date of the read', () => pm.expect(d.sourceVintage).to.match(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/));
pm.test('October 2025 was not published (shutdown): counted as missing, not stored', () => pm.expect(d.missingValues).to.be.at.least(3));
pm.test('every value already stored', () => pm.expect(d.unchanged + d.revised).to.eql(d.received));

item.name: 29 Miami-Dade unemployment rate: monthly, no October 2025, every value an ESTIMATE

exec: pm.test('no annual average mixed in', () => pm.expect(d.observations.every(o => o.periodStart.endsWith('-01'))).to.be.true);
pm.test('BLS county values are model-based: ESTIMATE', () => d.observations.forEach(o => pm.expect(o.observationKind).to.eql('ESTIMATE')));

item.description: Run in order. Requests 22-24 show the revision rules on the real Florida files; 27-28 use 2 of the 25 keyless BLS requests of the day.
